intro.line: An Omenpath opens in a sewer. Four turtles and a rat are waiting for pizza, and for trouble.
Past it, another Omenpath opens over a city where heroes in costumes defend a world that never asked for them.
Recorded: crossings sit outside Magic canon. You are only passing through, twice.

finale.line: The Titan falls. The stones go quiet, and the heroes stand together under a sky that is only a sky again.
They say the world moved on without me, but as long as injustice exists, I'm still needed here.
The Omenpaths fold shut, one after the other. The road turns back to the Multiverse.

villainFinale.line: In this version the Titan has what he came for. The universe is half as loud.
I shall restore the cosmic balance.
The last Omenpath flickers, and holds just long enough for you to leave.

battles.title: The Turtles
battles.blurb: A sewer, a katana and a clan that does not like turtles.

scene.line: Sneak: if an attacker is unblocked, return it to hand and put a stronger fighter in its place for the sneak cost.

villainScene.line: The Foot Elite are the personal students of the Shredder, a reserve guard without equal.
The Foot Clan: silent, patient and very sure they will win.

hero.half: Sneak a stronger attacker in once you are unblocked.

battles.title: Alliance
battles.blurb: A reporter with a camera, a gadget turtle and a street gang that picked the wrong alley.

scene.line: In the fight between mutants, ninjas, and aliens, don't underestimate a resourceful human.
Alliance: whenever another creature enters on your side, this one grows a little. Keep the crowd coming.

villainScene.line: These guys are young, but no rookies. They've fought and beat everything on two legs in this area . . . except us.
The Purple Dragons: every corner of the city, and a score to settle.

hero.start: Let me get this on camera.
hero.half: Each new creature boosts your allies.

battles.title: Krang
battles.blurb: The Technodrome is unfinished. Krang does not care.

scene.line: Anger is a dangerous ally. It clouds your judgment. You need to control it, lest it control you.
Krang makes you discard and mind-control your best fighter. Keep a spare card for the hit.

villainScene.line: You don't have to explain it to me, I'm the one who invented it!
Lord Krang is not in a hurry. The Technodrome will finish itself.

hero.half: Keep a spare card when he makes you discard.

battles.title: Super Shredder
battles.blurb: Mutagen, armor and a grudge older than the turtles.

scene.line: Yer right. We're just a scrappy band of mutants. We can't win. But boy, can we stir up trouble.
Disappear: if one of your permanents left play this turn, the creature makes a bonus Ninja token.

villainScene.line: I have molded myself into perfection, Hamato. Look upon me, and know fear.
Tonight, there will be turtle soup.

hero.half: Make a permanent leave play to light Disappear.

battles.title: Assemble
battles.blurb: A shield, a soldier and a cause that has outlasted decades.

scene.line: Our worst day is only where we start from. Where we *rise* from.
Teamwork: tap creatures with enough total power to boost a spell. A crowd turns a small spell into a big one.

villainScene.line: Minions of HYDRA! Behold! Our ultimate destiny is at hand!
HYDRA: cut off one head and two more shall take its place.

hero.half: Tap your team to double a spell.

battles.title: Power-Up
battles.blurb: The God of Thunder, a hammer and a brother who lies about everything.

scene.line: Now, my hammer shall speak for me . . . in a voice of thunder!
Power-up: pay once to put counters on a creature. It is cheaper the turn it enters.

villainScene.line: Foolish heroes. Loki can match you trick for trick, and *then* some.
A lie is nothing but a story. We can choose to tell a different one.

hero.half: Power-up a creature the turn it enters.

battles.title: Doctor Doom
battles.blurb: The Baxter Building against a monarch who is always three steps ahead.

scene.line: I'll hold down the fort while you guys bicker.
Doom answers your plays. Bait with a small spell first, then land the one that matters.

villainScene.line: I have seen your rightful place. Beneath me.
What fools you are that you cannot discern between a robotic servant and that which is . . . Doom!

hero.half: Bait his answers before the big play.

battles.title: The Mad Titan
battles.blurb: The Avengers stand in front of a Titan who wants half the universe.

scene.line: Trade small for big. The Titan wins if the game slows to a crawl.

villainScene.line: I shall restore the cosmic balance.

hero.half: Race him before the board stalls.

battles.title: The Coming of Galactus
battles.blurb: The sky darkens. Something far bigger than a Titan is coming.

archive.what: A black-green deck of the set's villains and heralds, with The Coming of Galactus at the top.
archive.why: It stands for the threat past the Titan and is not a list anyone won with.
archive.beat: Block the big heralds, chump the pack and race the saga before it ends.
archive.after: Nothing; this is the optional superboss at the end of the story.

deck.name: The Heralds of Galactus
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No tournament list is copied.

scene.line: C'mon girls, we're not here for snacks. Okay, maybe just one.
Small heroes, big stakes. Race the saga.

villainScene.line: I was stolen from paradise, but paradise never came looking for me.

after.line: Recorded: Galactus turns away for now. The Omenpaths close.

hero.half: Chump the heralds and race the saga.
